say:2:1041503901:1.text: Ah, old friend! It's been ages, and you're still the same—just as dull as ever.
say:2:1041503901:1.source_cn: 老朋友，这么长时间没见，你没有变啊，依然如此……无趣。

say:3:1041503902:1.text: Hmph, you haven't changed either, you frivolous brat.

say:4:1041503903:1.text: All you do is drink. I've never seen you do anything productive.
say:4:1041503903:1.source_cn: 你每天除了喝酒还是喝酒，吾从没见你干过什么正事。

say:5:1041503904:1.text: You're a terrible role model for the young.
say:5:1041503904:1.source_cn: 对于年轻人，你实在是个太坏的榜样。

say:6:1041503905:1.text: You really don't get it, do you? Time's meant to be savored, not wasted on those dreary old tunes of yours.
say:6:1041503905:1.source_cn: 顿里尔，你从不懂光阴珍贵，只知道拨弄你那些陈腐的乐章。

say:7:1041503906:1.text: If any poor soul actually listened to your advice, they'd be on the fast track to a miserable life.
say:7:1041503906:1.source_cn: 如果哪个年轻人听了你的教诲，才是不幸提前踏上了生之暮路。

say:8:1041503907:1.text: Dionel, you're not just frivolous, you're an idiot.
say:8:1041503907:1.source_cn: 萨基塔里斯，你不仅轻浮，而且愚蠢。

say:9:1041503908:1.text: Dunlingr, you're not just stuck in the past, you're also way too uptight.
say:9:1041503908:1.source_cn: 顿里尔，你不仅迂腐，还肚量狭隘。

say:10:1041503909:1.text: I'm just being honest, and you call me frivolous and foolish? Come on, lighten up!
say:10:1041503909:1.source_cn: 我只不过诚实地说出了自己的想法，就被你盖上了轻浮愚蠢的帽子。

say:11:1041503910:1.text: Relax, I'm here to sip some wine, not to debate the meaning of life.
say:11:1041503910:1.source_cn: 放轻松，我是来小酌的，不是来法庭争辩的。

say:12:1041503911:1.text: Hmph, even the chattering birds aren't as good at talking as you.
say:12:1041503911:1.source_cn: 哼，搬弄口舌的雀鸟都不如你会说。

say:14:1041503913:1.text: If I'd known you were here, I would've stayed home to compose!
say:14:1041503913:1.source_cn: 早知道你在，吾不如回去谱乐！

say:15:1041503914:1.text: Seriously though, I do admire your music—it's grand, it's powerful, it's... something.
say:15:1041503914:1.source_cn: 说真的，我很欣赏你的音乐。它们宏大激昂，一听就让人振奋。

say:16:1041503915:1.text: But you know, sometimes life needs a little more fun, a few more playful notes.
say:16:1041503915:1.source_cn: 但有的时候，你得学会在生活中插入一些舒缓悠闲的小调。

say:17:1041503916:1.text: Like right now... with a good glass of wine, isn't all this seriousness just a little out of place?
say:17:1041503916:1.source_cn: 就好像此刻……杯中美酒满溢，实在不适合发生这么严肃无趣...
